description: This file defines the TimeModuleController class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for handling time module-related requests within the HRM application. It extends an abstract controller, providing a handle method that redirects to the default time module path.

classes.name: TimeModuleController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling time module related actions, including redirecting to the default time module page.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request by redirecting the user to the default time module path.
